description: Convert YAML text or a base64 .yaml/.yml file into validated RFC 8259 JSON or JSON Lines (.jsonl). Supports multi-document YAML (--- separated Kubernetes/Helm manifests), safe YAML loading with alias-bomb protection, ISO-8601 date serialization, non-string key coercion, pretty (2/4 spaces or tabs) or minified output, and optional key sorting. Deterministic, 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/yaml-to-json.
